feed.title: ANTITRUST—D. Del.: Purported Golden Dome missile shield inventor’s antitrust claims against Lockheed Martin shot down in boost phase

feed.title: Moody’s takes minority stake in Phil Ratings to deepen PH debt market
feed.summary: Global credit rating agency Moody's Corp. has acquired a minority stake in Philippine Rating Services Corp. (PhilRatings) to strengthen its presence in the Philippine debt market.
